replay.imageProvenance: Independent local ordinary-mode reference/replay browser; no pixels captured by the server recorder.

limitations: Trusted fixed 2D fixture and trace transport only; not a production Chromium backend.
Images, filters, masking, non-SrcOver blending, 3D, iframe surfaces, Canvas, WebGL, video and copy-output are rejected or unverified.
SKP resources include embedded fonts; independent font/image deltas, DPR/zoom, resumption, cost and multi-worker handoff remain unverified.

fixture.fontPolicy: Pinned fixture webfont and explicit macOS antialiased (A8) CSS, matching the bounded CanvasKit text profile.

defaultFontSmoothing.scope: Initial fixture with browser-default font smoothing; whole image passes but independent header region fails.
